summary: Covers upgrading AAP 2.4 and 2.5 to 2.6 (and 2.6 patch releases) on OpenShift; upgrading the operator also upgrades the controller and hub it manages unless overridden, using OLM Subscription, CSV, InstallPlan and OperatorGroup objects.
questions: Does upgrading the AAP Operator upgrade automation controller too?
